en.io: Input: an assigned task. Output: more autonomous continuation and fewer hand-holding requests; no concrete artifact format is specified.
en.boundary: Contains only forcefully worded behavioral guidance. It defines no workflow, tools, validation method, safety policy, inputs, or technical implementation, so it cannot by itself perform or verify work.
scenarios: Reduce unnecessary progress confirmations during a multi-step task.
Encourage continued execution when the next action is already implied by the assignment.

zh.io: 输入：已分配任务。输出：更自主的持续执行和更少的逐步确认；未规定具体制品格式。
zh.boundary: 仅包含措辞强烈的行为指导，没有定义工作流、工具、验证方法、安全策略、输入结构或技术实现，因此自身无法执行或验证具体工作。
scenarios: 减少多步骤任务中不必要的进度确认。
当下一步已由任务隐含确定时，鼓励代理继续执行。
